parameters.content:
## Test the deployed logic without writing tickets
1. In Run 01 support choose your configured/published 01 Gemini or Claude workflow. No field mappings.
2. Select Gemini credential on the Judge.
3. Execute RUN EVALUATION. Fifteen cases run serially.
4. Open Evaluation report, JSON view; copy/save the actual report as eval-before.json. Inspect failed answers AND chunks.
5. Make one explainable change, label it after-fix in 15 fixed policy questions, rerun, save eval-after.json. Do not invent failures or a 15/15 result.

An internal-only trigger enables eval mode. Chat prompts cannot switch off real safeguards or enable eval mode.
